incident.name: HEAT-2026-DUBAI-REF
incident.narrative: A multi-day heat dome coincides with a large outdoor event. Cooling centres in both sectors are filling. Oral rehydration salts and shade-shelter kits are under contention, and two field epidemiology teams have been requested. All sector names are generic; no real location is described.
objectives: Prevent heat-related mortality across both sectors for the duration of the event.
Maintain cooling-centre capacity above 20 percent headroom in each sector.
Keep oral rehydration salts above reorder point at every cooling centre.
Sustain 20/40 rotation compliance for all outdoor field teams.
Produce a situation report each operational period with explicit information gaps.
